title: Why TikTok might get banned again in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if TikTok disappears from your phone in 2026?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: New laws could force its removal over data security fears.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: TikTok might be banned again if it doesn’t meet U.S. data rules.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The app stores user data on servers in China, raising concerns.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could affect 150 million U.S. users who rely on the app daily.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key issue? Control over personal data and national security.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Will you still use TikTok if it’s banned? Let me know below.
